snippet.title: Apricity - Official Trailer (2025) | Upcoming Indie Roguelike Adventure
snippet.description:
✨ Wishlist Apricity on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3037650/Apricity ✨

APRICITY – A Warm Light In The Dark
Official Trailer 2025

Fight, farm and bake your way through ancient canals and the crumbling castles of APRICITY. 
Gather strength by fishing waterways, harvesting ingredients and slaying ancient beasts. 
Rekindle the lost light and push back the hungering darkness.

🧭 Join the community:
🍄Discord: https://discord.gg/4byGGrQuxm
🍄Website: https://www.trickbytegames.com/
🍄Instagram: https://instagram.com/trickbytegames
🍄TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@trickbytegames
🍄Twitter: https://x.com/TrickbyteGames

Apricity is an upcoming indie roguelike/roguelite adventure game blending cozy farming, baking, and action combat.
Explore ancient canals and crumbling castles in a whimsical, atmospheric world filled with mystery and magic.
Fish mystical waterways, harvest rare ingredients, and slay powerful ancient beasts to grow stronger.
Craft baked goods to boost your abilities permanently and face the encroaching darkness head-on.

If you love atmospheric roguelikes with unique twists, rich exploration, and cozy yet challenging gameplay, Apricity is for you.

#indiegame #gamedev #roguelike #cozygames #ApricityGame
